Now coming to operating me trics, volume of polymer processed in Q1 FY27 was 6,323 metric ton against 5,056 metric ton in Q4 FY26, an increase of 25% and against 7,399 metric ton in Q1 FY26.
Growth & demand: Volume of polymers processed rose to 6,323 metric tons from 5,056 metric tons in the preceding quarter, an increase of over 25% and capacity utilization improved from 65% to nearly 65% from our 52% in Q4 FY26 at a 39,000 metric ton capacity.

So, EBITDA grew 6.8% sequentially in absolute terms while the margin held broadly flat.
Capex & expansion: For FY27, we target to achieve the utilization of approximately 75% at a capacity of 41,000 metric tons.

Capacity utilization improved to 64.9% from 51.9% in Q4 FY26 and compares with 89.7% in Q1 FY26, which was measured against a smaller installed base for that quarter prior to the Khatalwada expansion.

Our balance sheet with debt to equity at 0.14 times is very robust.
